decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans 2813/P/01, 2813/P/02, 2813/L/01, 2813/L/02, 2813/L/03, 2813/L/04, Design and Access Statement, Flood Risk Assessment and Planning Statement received 21st April 2008  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The approved building P as shown on drawing 2813/S/02 shall be used as either a clinic, health centre, cr?che, day nursery or consulting room use and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class D1 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that order without the modification).

Condition : 5 - All existing windows and doors to building L shall be retained in situ and any replacements shall be approved in writing by Local Planning Authority before any work on the site is commenced.
Condition : 6 - The Class B1 and D1 uses hereby permitted shall not operate outside the following times 8am to 7.00pm Mondays to Fridays and 10.00am to 5.00pm on Saturday, Sunday and Public Holidays.
Condition : 7 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 8 - No deliveries shall be taken at or despatched from the site outside the hours of 7am to midday nor at any time on Sundays, Bank or Public Holidays.

Condition : 9 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 8 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 10 - Before first occupation of the buildings the loading, unloading and turning space, and parking spaces (including spaces for people with disabilities) shall be provided within the curtilage of the site in accordance with the scheme shown on drawing No. 2813/S/02 and such spaces shall be permanently available and not be used for any other purpose.

Condition : 11 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to buildings L and P as shown on drawing 2813/S/02 shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.

Condition : 12 - No development shall take place until details of a Sustainable Drainage Scheme, including measures for the harvesting of rainwater, the minimisation of water run-off from the building, by at least 50% of that of the undeveloped site, and the conservation and reuse as appropriate of other water supplies in the building have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 14 - No development shall take place until details have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority, for a scheme of reducing carbon emissions from the total energy needs (heat, cooling and power) of the development by at least 20%, by the on-site generation of renewable energy, unless it can be demonstrated that such a provision is not feasible. The details shall be carried out as approved.

Condition : 15 - The approved building P, as shown on drawing 2813/S/02, for D1 use shall not be occupied until evidence has been submitted to the Local Planning Authority that a licence has been issued to the developer for the use by occupants of the development hereby approved and occupiers of buildings M, N and O shown on the drawings hereby approved of 10 off street car parking spaces in the adjacent basement car park in the Ferry Quays development immediately to the east of the site.
description: New single storey D1 building (Building P) comprising two units. Extension and refurbishment to existing building (Building L).
